status: Recorded before input-reference captures and input-parameter mutations
scope: Active gameplay, existing default control mode, right-button grab starting over empty steel, live mouse swap disabled and inversion factor as observed
falsifier: Grab not active, selected object blocks it, observed yaw differs from predeclared value, loaded level changes, or input polling stops. Do not fit step counts or deltas afterward.
pixel_policy: Existing fixed ROI and0.02 normalized RGB error, unchanged. Candidate yaw must be computed from input plus executable coefficients, not copied from the resulting live angle.
restore: Release input after each operation; apply declared opposite input; verify original camera bytes before next case. A timeout or failed restore invalidates the affected case.
